# Yoranix

> Yoranix is a digital solutions company based in Sydney, Australia, serving clients
> globally. Tagline: "Digital Solutions. Real Impact." It delivers end-to-end digital
> solutions for education providers and enterprises: complete Moodle LMS solutions,
> server hosting and maintenance, cloud infrastructure and DevOps, and custom
> integrations and automation — as modular offerings or one managed service.

## Services

- [Services overview](/services): Complete Moodle Solution (setup, theming, plugins,
  training); Server Hosting & Maintenance (VPS, backups, security hardening,
  monitoring); Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps (CI/CD, Kubernetes/Docker,
  observability); Custom Integrations & Automation (APIs, SIS/CRM connectors, SSO,
  automated reporting).

## Key pages

- [Home](/): What Yoranix does, who it serves, client testimonials, and FAQs.
- [FAQ](/faq): Plain answers on Moodle hosting, cloud/DevOps scope, integrations,
  industries served, location, support, and how to get started.
- [Request a Service](/request-service): Proposal request form; response within one
  business day with milestones, SLAs, and pricing.
- [Book a Meeting](/book-meeting): Consultation scheduling via Google Calendar.
- [Contact](/contact): Email, phone, and location details.

## Who Yoranix serves

Colleges and training providers; enterprises and SMEs; edtech startups.
